meaning: Being moved is the actualization of an unactualized capacity (OPEN), and potency is unactualized capacity (Metaphysics IX.6 reading, stated); hence being moved is the actualization of a potency, the Physics III.1 reading. Middle term: unactualized capacity. Composes with POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY-FROM-PRIVATION.

strong_version_needed.STMT-POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY: Both directions of the potency analysis are used at every being and respect: unactualized capacity to potency for the forward direction of the conclusion, and potency to unactualized capacity for the converse, including at tuples that are not moved. The weak version STMT-MOVED-TUPLE-POTENCY-HAS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY gives only the second direction, only at moved tuples.
